The plate is roughly 26 cm across and spans about 450 px, which works out to about 0.058 cm per px.

The meat pieces cover about 170 px by 60 px, which is roughly 10 cm by 3.5 cm. That looks like 2-3 thin slices of steak, each about 1 cm thick. Together they come to about 10 × 3.5 × 1.5 cm, or around 50 cm³. That is roughly 55 g, so I'll round up to about 60 g.

Cooked flank steak runs about 2 kcal/g, so 60 g gives roughly 120 kcal. Allowing a little for sauce brings it to about 130 kcal.

{"kcal": 130, "mass_g": 60}
